text:
megan: Heads-up — we got a pulse from billing: several customer requests were charged to org-default instead of project buckets after yesterday's attr-sampler roll. Not huge, but visible.

ryan: Any correlation id or example request?

megan: req=0a9b8c7d. Incoming header: `Authorization: ApiKey org=org-44 proj_ref=prod-42 token=sk_...` Proxy rewrote to `X-Org-Id: org-44` and `X-Project-Ref: prod-42`. After routing the trace shows only `X-Org-Id`.

devon: I think the sampler dedupe step collapsed header variants and we lost the project header name. The binder only recognizes `X-Project-Id` or `proj_id` claim, not `X-Project-Ref`.

akira: Also noticed the sampler config changed ordering to prefer key-affinity over explicit headers to cut noise in observability tests. That would make header-derived origin lower priority and susceptible to being dropped.

sam: quick mitigation: we can add a compatibility map in authn that accepts `X-Project-Ref` -> `proj_id` and flip sampler ordering for the canary. But long-term we should converge on canonical header names in the router contract.

megan: UX ask: console shows "Attributed to org" with no context. Can we surface why project was missing? A tiny badge like "project header dropped in routing" would save support triage time.

support-bot: action created: #TICKET-1426 — add attribution hint in request detail (reporter=megan)

ryan: If we add a short-field `orig_headers` to the sampler decision (keeps a map of seen header keys), binder can prefer token claims then `orig_headers`, then final headers. That preserves provenance without huge changes.

akira: Also emit metric `auth.attribution.fallback_reason` with tags `header_lost`, `header_name_mismatch`, `token_only`. That will let us break down by token type (SA vs user).

sam: I'll implement the `orig_headers` carry-forward and the metric. Devon — can you ship the compat map to staging?

devon: Yep. Pushing auth-compat mapping to staging now. Will run the synthetic mixed-key test (user key, SA, cross-org SA) and post numbers.

megan: Thanks. After staging looks good let's run a short canary for 1 hour and check `billing.project_charges` vs baseline. If stable, roll. Also update support playbook with the new console hint and the grafana filter query.

sam: PR opened for metrics + sampler change. Added unit tests for header provenance. Will ping when dashboards show the new metric. :thumbsup:

megan: Great — please add the short tooltip text to the ticket: "Project not found — header likely dropped or header name mismatch. Check router canonicalization and sampler ordering."

ryan: noted. I'll also add a lint rule to fail builds if router and binder header contracts diverge.

megan: Awesome. Keeping this thread as the rollout tracker.
